title: Resident Desk Guidance — Waiving Fees on Home Purchase Financing Loans
content:
**Guidance note: fee waivers on Home Purchase Financing loans**

**What a waiver does.** A waiver removes the whole fee it names and is posted against that fee. A fee that already carries a waiver is not waived again; whether it does is read from the loan's transaction record of waivers posted against that same fee.

**Servicer-error basis.** A late charge or returned-payment fee caused by a servicer error — a payment received in time but posted late, or an autopay draft the servicer failed to send — is waived on the servicer-error basis without limit.

**Courtesy basis.** A courtesy waiver applies to late charges only, at most the program's number of courtesy late-charge waivers in the trailing 12 months, and only while the loan is active. The courtesy waivers counted are those on the loan recorded on the courtesy basis, by their date, in the trailing 12 calendar months ending on and including the handling date.

**Never as a courtesy.** Returned-payment fees and deferment fees are never waived as a courtesy.

### Bases at a glance

| Fee | Servicer-error basis | Courtesy basis |
|---|---|---|
| Late charge | yes, when caused by a servicer error, without limit | yes, within the trailing-12-month count and only while the loan is active |
| Returned-payment fee | yes, when caused by a servicer error, without limit | never |
| Deferment fee | — | never |

### Points of judgement (hypothetical loans, a courtesy allowance taken as 1)

- An active loan with no courtesy waiver in the trailing 12 months may have one late charge waived as a courtesy.
- The same loan with a courtesy waiver dated within the trailing 12 calendar months, the handling date included, has used its allowance.
- A delinquent loan cannot receive a courtesy waiver, since the courtesy basis applies only while the loan is active.
- A late charge that already carries a waiver is not waived again on any basis.
